issues.title: [Bug]: Extremely subtle exponential time progression if Aerial Hell is installed

labels.name: mod conflict
labels.description: This issue is caused by a mod conflict that cannot be resolved on this end

issues.body:
### Minecraft Version

1.20.1

### What happened?

Using Comforts 6.4.0+1.20.1
Using Aerial Hell 0.7.0 for 1.20.1

Place bed
/time query day
/time add 18000 (make it night)
Sleep
/time query day
repeat

The day progresses 3, then 6, then 12, then 24, etc. days, to days 3, 9, 21, 45, etc.
That's a doubling of the progression time of days.
This isn't particularly visible except if you're also playing with a seasons mod or something else that cares about the day.
But with seasons, it completely breaks the experience as sleeping starts to skip entire seasons.

I'm assuming that Aerial Hell is overriding something that the 6.4.0 version of Comforts depends on, probably for the dayWakeTimeOffset and nightWakeTimeOffset features in 6.4.0.
There are probably other mods that could cause this as well, but I haven't found them.

Rolling Comforts back to 6.3.5+1.20.1 resolves this issue.

### Loader

Fabric

_No response_

issues.title: [Bug]: Crash on Mob Conversion Due to Outdated Cardinal Components in Comforts 1.21.4

labels.name: status: confirmed
labels.description: This issue or pull request has been accepted

issues.body:
### Minecraft Version

1.21.4

### What happened?

Hi! im running Minecraft 1.21.4 with fabric, and I encountered a crash when conversions was taking place (eg zombie to drowned or villager to zombie). After some investigation, I found the crash is caused by an AbstractMethodError related to the ServerLivingEntityEvents.MOB_CONVERSION event, triggered by Fabric Entity Events API.

From what I can tell the crash appears to be caused by comforts bundling an outdated version of Cardinal Components API.

Crash caused by - org.ladysanke.cca.internal.entity.-CardinalComponentsEntity missing onConversion method 

Crash fixed by - Manually installing the latest version of Cardinal-Components-API

Please it would be amazing if you could update Comforts dependency or bundled version of Cardinal Components API to version 6.2.2 for game versions 1.21.2-1.21.4 which includes the required OnConverstion implementation for Fabric Entity events.

Thank you for maintaining Comforts and getting it onto 1.21.4 - Its a great mod like many of your others! I look forward to hopefully seeing some more of your mods on 1.21.4 soon!

Thank you.

issues.title: [Bug]: Comforts annotates `CreativeModTab.makeIcon` as `OnlyIn(Dist.CLIENT)` despite the vanilla method being present on both sides.

labels.name: status: confirmed
labels.description: This issue or pull request has been accepted

issues.body:
### Minecraft Version

1.18.2

### What happened?

As seen here:

https://github.com/illusivesoulworks/comforts/blob/4760e56ce25863d9f4c7da92f19dad212e9fca70/forge/src/main/java/top/theillusivec4/comforts/ComfortsMod.java#L81

Comforts is annotating a vanilla method as `@OnlyIn(Dist.CLIENT)`, which causes it to be not present in dedicated server, despite **the vanilla method not being annotated as such**. In particular, vanilla stopped side-specific method stripping like this since 1.17.

This has the effect of stripping out the method implementation in a dedicated server, meaning any other mod which calls `makeIcon()` has the potential to cause a crash.

### How do you trigger this bug?

This can be triggered via any code that calls `CreativeModeTab.makeIcon()` on a dedicated server, for any creative tab. As it will error with an `AbstractMethodError` due to the required implementation not being present on server.
